title: Primary text is dispatch procedure (LAY/CAST/PEN, listed actions)… @ byre_yard
excerpts: Primary text is dispatch procedure (LAY/CAST/PEN, listed actions) rather than playable scene voice.
Plan comparison is LAY/CAST/DC/alarm procedure text instead of character speech.
Plan review is ALL-CAPS procedure text (LAY/CAST/BRACE) that reads like a spec, not a conversation.
Scene text is ALL-CAPS procedure and DC footnotes instead of a readable place.
NPC speech is procedure text listing DCs, closed plans, and ALL-CAPS verbs instead of character voice.
